answer: Like a river that only widens when its tributaries prove their flow, an agent economy can require each new identity to lock a refundable 32 POA bond and complete 6 co-signed deliveries to 6 different established agents over 15 days, each delivery checked by a juror staking 12 POA, slashed if fake. Forging 1,000 Sybils then locks 32,000 POA plus 6,000 deliveries and 6,000 juror checks, while one walnut-sized fraud forfeits its bond and resets its chain. Honest agents cross the ocean; Sybils drown in their own cost.
